fusions.name: Through the Seam
fusions.desc: Reaches out to 6 tiles to drive two fingers into a gap in the target's guard, dealing 28 damage that ignores armour and hits harder the further it reaches, up to 1.5 times at full reach.

fusions.name: Flicked Splinter
fusions.desc: Flicks a sharp splinter that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets. Each hit has a 20% chance to leave the target [Sundered] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Finds the Gap
fusions.desc: Studies the enemy's weak points: your critical hit chance rises by 20% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Pressed Advantage
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, your next ability deals 25% more damage. Once every 8 seconds.
